faq.a1: Yes, completely free with no limits. No subscriptions, no premium tiers.
faq.q2: Are my files sent to a server?
faq.a2: Exports can run locally in your browser or send Markdown to your configured render server so long documents can be generated faster.
faq.a3: We support GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) including tables, task lists, and code blocks.
faq.q4: Can I use this on mobile?
faq.a4: Absolutely! MarkdownTools is fully responsive and works great on phones and tablets.
faq.q5: What file formats can I export to?
faq.a5: You can export to PDF, HTML, and plain text (TXT) formats.
